scope_note: 132 E east Great Australian Bight, modeled 100 m velocity. Local monthly-mean eastward-component spans; association and obliquity unresolved. No CARS/MOM01 reproduction, flow-normal width, whole-current dimensions or seasonal footprint.
layer: HYCOM+NCODA reanalysis velocity interpolated to 100 m; not a direct 100 m observation or uniform-depth envelope.
time_convention: All 366 daily 00Z 2012 analyses; monthly complete-pair means with at least 80% of calendar-day support. One leap year, not climatology or annual physical extrema.
